CookieNotice.title: Cookies and measurement
CookieNotice.description: Findelio uses necessary cookies for sign-in, sessions and language selection. Optional analytics helps us improve the site and only loads after you choose it.

CookiePolicy.metaDescription: Which technically necessary cookies and local browser storage Findelio uses and how long they remain stored.
CookiePolicy.title: Cookie information
CookiePolicy.intro: This page explains which cookies and similar storage technologies Findelio uses. Optional Google Analytics measurement is activated only after your explicit choice.
CookiePolicy.necessaryText: Findelio uses technically necessary cookies for sign-in, secure sessions and language selection. They are set automatically when needed.
CookiePolicy.analyticsText: If you allow analytics, we load Google Analytics (measurement ID G-S9DSK103GX). Usage data, device information and an approximate location may be sent to Google, and analytics cookies such as _ga may be set. You can reset your choice by deleting local website data in your browser.
CookiePolicy.inventoryText: Necessary cookies come directly from Findelio. Optional Google analytics cookies are set only after your consent.

access.purpose: Keeps your secure sign-in active during the current session.
access.duration: Short-lived; expires automatically with the access token.

refresh.purpose: Securely renews your sign-in without requiring your password on every page.
refresh.duration: Up to 7 days or until you sign out.

locale.purpose: Remembers your chosen language during the browser session.
locale.duration: Until the end of the browser session.

CookiePolicy.storageText: The cookie notice and your analytics choice are stored in your browser's local storage.
CookiePolicy.storagePurpose: Stores when you confirmed the notice and whether you allowed or rejected optional analytics.
CookiePolicy.storageDuration: Up to 12 months or until you delete your browser data.
CookiePolicy.controlText: You can view and delete cookies and local website data at any time in your browser settings. If you block or delete necessary cookies, sign-in, language selection or other protected areas may no longer work reliably.
CookiePolicy.privacyText: Our privacy policy explains how Findelio processes personal data and which rights you have.

CompanyGuide.metaTitle: How Findelio works for businesses | Findelio
CompanyGuide.metaDescription: From company account to published listing: learn how businesses use Findelio and what Premium adds.
CompanyGuide.title: Your Findelio listing in just a few steps.
CompanyGuide.intro: Findelio connects your business with people looking for advice and services in their language. You stay in control of your information and choose Free or Premium for each listing.

register.text: Register with your email address and confirm it using the link in the confirmation email.

listing.text: Add your business listing, select relevant industries and languages, and choose Free or Premium.

complete.title: Complete the profile
complete.text: Add a description, contact details and address. Premium also includes a logo, gallery, opening hours, social links and translations.

review.title: Submit for review
review.text: Findelio reviews new and changed content to keep the directory reliable, current and free from misuse.

publish.title: Publish and grow
publish.text: After approval your listing becomes visible. Only then do you activate a reserved Premium plan and gain access to posts and statistics.

CompanyGuide.reviewText: Review protects visitors and reputable businesses. Findelio checks that information is plausible and belongs to a genuine business. You receive a message if we have questions or reject content.
CompanyGuide.verificationTitle: Earn Verified status with official evidence
CompanyGuide.verificationText: You may voluntarily send Findelio current official evidence of your business. After a successful check, we mark your business listing as ‘Verified’.
CompanyGuide.verificationProofs: Suitable evidence includes a current commercial-register or UID-register extract. For sole proprietorships not entered in the commercial register, confirmation from the social-security compensation office recognising self-employed status may also be used.
CompanyGuide.verificationNote: The Verified badge only confirms that Findelio checked the existence or association of the business using submitted evidence. It is not a guarantee of quality, creditworthiness, licences or services.
CompanyGuide.ctaText: Create your free account, complete your profile and be found by the right customers.

Terms.metaDescription: Terms and Conditions for business accounts, listings and Premium subscriptions on Findelio.
Terms.title: Terms and Conditions
Terms.intro: These Terms govern the use of Findelio by businesses, organisations and their authorised users. Please read them carefully before registering or purchasing a Premium subscription.

scope.title: Provider and scope
scope.body: Findelio is provided by Webpixels, Jan Cabanik, Kirchgasse 13, 8532 Warth, Switzerland. These Terms apply to business accounts, organisations, listings, and free and paid Findelio features.

services.title: Findelio services
services.body: Findelio operates a multilingual business directory and provides tools to create, review, publish and manage business listings. Findelio facilitates visibility and contact but is not a party to contracts between visitors and listed businesses.

accounts.title: Accounts and authority
accounts.body: Registration details must be accurate and current. Login credentials must be kept confidential. Anyone acting for an organisation confirms that they are authorised to do so. Account holders are responsible for activity performed through their account.

content.title: Content and licence
content.body: Businesses are responsible for their text, contact details, images, logos, links and other content. They confirm that information is truthful, current and lawful and does not infringe third-party rights. For the publication period, Findelio receives the non-exclusive rights needed to store, display and technically process this content for the directory.

review.title: Review, rejection and suspension
review.body: Findelio may review new and changed content before publication. Illegal, misleading, incomplete, abusive or insufficient-quality content may be rejected, deferred, suspended or deleted. Where appropriate, Findelio will explain the decision and allow corrections.

packages.title: Free and Premium
packages.body: The Free plan includes the displayed basic features. Premium applies per business listing and includes the additional features described on the offer and billing pages. Features may evolve without unreasonably reducing the essential value of a current paid period.

contract.title: Contract, prices and payment
contract.body: Current prices are displayed in Swiss francs including any applicable charges. Before purchase, the plan, billing interval and price are shown again. The Premium contract begins when payment is confirmed. Monthly and annual subscriptions renew for the selected interval unless cancelled before the end of the period.

cancellation.title: Cancellation and failed payments
cancellation.body: Premium can be cancelled through subscription management effective at the end of the current billing period. Features remain available until then. Following a failed payment, Premium access may be blocked no later than the end of the period. Used or partly used periods are generally not refunded; mandatory legal rights remain unaffected.

availability.title: Availability and development
availability.body: Findelio aims to operate reliably but does not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free availability. Maintenance, security measures, third-party outages or force majeure may cause interruptions. Features may be reasonably adapted or replaced.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: Findelio remains liable where required by mandatory law. To the extent permitted, liability for slight negligence, indirect loss, lost profits and data loss is excluded. Businesses remain responsible for their content, offers and transactions with visitors.

termination.title: Termination and account deletion
termination.body: Users may request account deletion unless legal retention duties or open contractual relationships prevent it. Deleting an account does not cancel an active Premium subscription. Findelio may suspend or terminate access for serious or repeated violations after reasonably considering the interests involved.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Personal data is processed under the current Findelio Privacy Policy. Businesses are responsible for personal data they publish in their listings.

changes.title: Changes to these Terms
changes.body: Findelio may amend these Terms prospectively for legal, technical or business reasons. Material changes will be communicated appropriately. Paid periods will not be subject to unreasonable retroactive disadvantages.

law.title: Governing law and jurisdiction
law.body: Swiss law applies, excluding conflict-of-law rules. Where legally permitted, the courts at the registered location of Webpixels have jurisdiction. Mandatory venues and protections remain unaffected. If translations conflict, the German version prevails.

verification.title: Verified business listings
verification.body: Businesses may voluntarily submit a current commercial-register or UID-register extract or comparable official evidence. For sole proprietorships not entered in the commercial register, Findelio may in particular accept confirmation from the social-security compensation office recognising self-employed status. After a successful check, Findelio may mark the listing as ‘Verified’. The badge only confirms the existence or association of the business checked using the evidence; it is not a guarantee of quality, creditworthiness, licences or services. Findelio may request further information or remove the status if information becomes outdated, contradictory or false. Evidence is used solely for verification, made accessible only to authorised persons, and deleted when no longer required for that purpose unless a retention obligation applies.

Legal.imprintMetaDescription: Operator and contact details for Findelio.
Legal.imprintIntro: Findelio is a service provided by Webpixels. This page contains the legally relevant operator and contact details.
Legal.contentResponsibilityText: Jan Cabanik is responsible for Findelio’s editorial content and can be reached using the contact details above.
Legal.liabilityText: Content is prepared with care. However, Webpixels does not guarantee its accuracy, completeness, timeliness or continuous availability. Mandatory statutory liability remains unaffected.
Legal.externalLinksText: The respective operators are responsible for linked websites and information supplied by businesses. Unlawful content will be removed once we become aware of it and have reviewed it.
Legal.copyrightText: Findelio’s content and design are protected by copyright. Any use beyond statutory exceptions requires the prior consent of the respective rights holder.
Legal.privacyMetaDescription: Information about the processing of personal data by Findelio.
Legal.privacyIntro: This privacy policy explains which personal data Findelio processes, why it is processed and which rights you have. Swiss data protection law applies; where applicable, we also take the GDPR into account.
Legal.controllerText: The controller responsible for data processing in connection with Findelio is:
Legal.processedDataIntro: Depending on how you use Findelio, we process the following categories of personal data:
Legal.technicalData: Technical usage data such as IP address, time, requested page, browser and device information, and server logs. This data supports secure and stable operation.
Legal.accountData: For registration and sign-in: name, email address, account status and securely stored authentication data. Passwords are not stored in plain text.
Legal.listingData: For organisations and business listings: business, contact and address details, descriptions, industries, languages, and voluntarily uploaded media and profile information.
Legal.contactData: For the contact form: name, email address, optional telephone number, subject and message. The IP address is used briefly for rate limiting to prevent abuse.
Legal.purposesText: We process data to provide the directory, manage accounts and business listings, operate review and notification workflows, answer enquiries, prevent abuse, and maintain the security, stability and development of the service.
Legal.legalBasisText: Processing takes place to take steps before entering into and to perform a contract, based on overriding private interests in a secure and functional service, to comply with legal obligations, or with your consent where consent is required.
Legal.cookiesText: Findelio uses technically necessary cookies for authentication and session management. Optional Google Analytics measurement is loaded only after explicit consent and may set analytics cookies. We do not embed a map.
Legal.recipientsText: Infrastructure and hosting providers may process data as processors to the extent necessary. We use Infomaniak Network SA in Switzerland to send email. If you allow optional analytics, measurement data is sent to Google Ireland Limited and related Google services. Data is disclosed only where necessary to operate the service, where required by law, initiated by you, or covered by your consent. If data is processed abroad, we ensure appropriate protection under applicable data protection law.
Legal.retentionText: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for its purpose, account administration, handling an enquiry, security or statutory retention duties. Data that is no longer required is deleted or anonymised.
Legal.securityText: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures, including access controls, encrypted transmission and secured systems. Nevertheless, completely risk-free data transmission cannot be guaranteed.
Legal.rightsText: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, provision or transfer of your data, object to processing, or withdraw consent. Contact info@findelio.ch. You may also contact the competent data protection supervisory authority.
Legal.thirdPartyText: Business listings may link to third-party websites and social media services. The relevant provider’s privacy terms apply only after you open such a link. Findelio does not embed a map on the contact page.
Legal.changesText: We may update this privacy policy when features, service providers or legal requirements change. The version published on this page is the current version.
